# Test fixtures

Fake candidate materials for exercising the tool end to end. Nothing here
describes a real person.

- `dummy_resume.pdf`, `dummy_cover_letter.pdf` — generated by
  `generate_dummy_documents.py` (regenerate with
  `python testdata/generate_dummy_documents.py`, needs `pip install fpdf2`,
  not a runtime dependency of the tool itself).
- `dummy_profile.json` — candidate profile pointing at the two PDFs above.
- `test_urls.txt` — 9 real, individual job postings (3 Greenhouse, 3 Lever,
  3 Ashby), found via web search. **Verify each link still resolves to an
  open posting before you run a batch** — search snapshots can lag reality,
  and this list was not run against live because this environment's network
  policy blocks these domains and no LLM API key was configured here.

## Running the actual test (from `job-application-automation-py/`)

Single job, dry run (fills + screenshots, does not submit):

```bash
python cli.py "https://boards.greenhouse.io/earnin/jobs/5934502" testdata/dummy_profile.json \
  --headed --provider anthropic   # or --provider groq
```

All 9, queue mode with batch review (still headed, still asks
submit/skip per job — see the top-level README for what this does and
does not automate):

```bash
python cli_queue.py testdata/test_urls.txt testdata/dummy_profile.json --provider anthropic
```

Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (or `GROQ_API_KEY` with `--provider groq`) first.
Expect some of the 9 to need a manual CAPTCHA solve or to have a form
layout the field-scanner doesn't fully recognize (dropdowns without a
`<label for>`, multi-step flows, etc.) — that's the point of reviewing the
screenshot/answers before deciding to submit anything, and worth reporting
back so the scanner/labels can be improved.
